spec.name: Furniture Pumpkin Wheelbarrow
spec.description: A rustic dark oak wheelbarrow with a chunky stepped wooden wheel, long handles, grounded rear legs and a straw-filled tray carrying two orange pumpkins and one cream pumpkin. Front faces negative Z. All geometry is axis-aligned; the wheel and legs meet the floor.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: rustic dark oak wheelbarrow with one chunky wooden wheel, two handles, straw and three orange and cream pumpkins; autumn porch decoration. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..16, z=0..32; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Standing on floor y=0. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
